articles.title: New Tariffs Raise the Risk of a More Hawkish Fed, Economists Warn
articles.excerpt: Proposed duties on 14 trading partners would lift the effective US tariff rate above 13%, economists estimate, just as core PCE inflation printed 3.3% in October.
articles.image_caption: The Federal Reserve headquarters in Washington.
articles.nri_angle: Higher-for-longer US rates keep mortgage, credit-card and remittance-era borrowing costs elevated for diaspora households into 2027.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Proposes Tariffs of Up to 25% on India; GTRI Urges New Delhi to Reject Deal
articles.excerpt: Washington's Section 301 excess-capacity findings offer India 17% if it signs a trade agreement — a dual rate the GTRI think tank calls coercive bait.
articles.nri_angle: Indian exporters and US-based importers of Indian goods face a proposed 25% duty, or 17% under a trade deal, with comments open until January 5, 2027.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dow Erases 1,100-Point Drop to Close Higher as Bargain Hunters Step In
articles.excerpt: The Nasdaq fell more than 4% early on Wednesday in an AI-led selloff sharpened by new US tariff proposals — then recovered most of the loss, closing down just 0.62% as value stocks outperformed ahead of Thanksgiving.
articles.image_caption: Traders work on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange in New York. US indexes recovered most of a steep early loss on November 25, 2026, with the Dow closing higher and the Nasdaq down 0.62%.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American investors holding US index and AI stocks saw a 4% intraday Nasdaq fall narrow to a 0.62% close, with markets shut Thursday for Thanksgiving.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Cabinet Approves ₹11,000 Crore Scheme to Build Construction Equipment in India
articles.excerpt: The eight-year scheme offers sales-linked incentives of 13% to 8% to equipment and component makers and up to ₹375 crore for a dedicated testing facility, as more than half of India's roughly ₹1 lakh crore equipment demand is still imported.
articles.image_caption: A construction site with tower cranes, photographed in Cologne, Germany, in 2017. India's Cabinet has approved a ₹11,000 crore scheme to manufacture more construction and infrastructure equipment domestically.
articles.nri_angle: The scheme targets import substitution in heavy equipment, relevant to diaspora investors tracking India's manufacturing and infrastructure supply chains.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Surges Over 2,000 Points Intraday as Record Foreign Inflows Power Rally
articles.excerpt: The Sensex traded up 2.46 per cent by late morning on November 25 and the Nifty hit 25,951.65 intraday, as FIIs extended a 16-session buying streak and November inflows reached a record $13.2 billion.
articles.nri_angle: Record foreign inflows into Indian equities directly affect NRI portfolios and India-focused funds held by the diaspora; the figures here are intraday, not closing, levels.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to Step Down After Decade at Helm
articles.excerpt: Flipkart confirmed the Group CEO's exit on November 25. His last day is reported to be December 4, with a successor to be named in the coming weeks and the IPO still deferred.
articles.image_caption: Flipkart headquarters and Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy, in an image published by Mint. Flipkart confirmed on November 25 that Krishnamurthy will step down, with a successor to be announced in the coming weeks.
articles.nri_angle: Flipkart is the largest company in Walmart's India portfolio; its leadership change and deferred IPO shape one of the biggest consumer-internet businesses Indian investors and shoppers follow.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

dates.event: Flipkart plans to file IPO draft papers

articles.title: US Readies New Tariffs on 16 Partners, India Included, as Soon as Tuesday
articles.excerpt: Reuters reports the Section 301 excess-capacity findings could land Tuesday or Wednesday, with country-tailored duties proposed on top of existing tariffs — but no rates announced yet.
articles.nri_angle: India is one of the 16 partners in the probe, so any proposed rate would land directly on Indian exporters selling into the US and on US importers sourcing from India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Pharma Sector, Now Around $60 Billion, Is Projected to Reach $130 Billion by 2030
articles.excerpt: At CPHI India in New Delhi, industry leaders tied the projection to a shift from volume generics to complex generics, biosimilars and innovative therapies — with exports of $30.47 billion in FY2024-25 as the base.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors, the investable question is whether Indian pharma earnings shift from commodity generics toward higher-value biosimilars and complex therapies.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rent From an Indian Flat Is Taxable in India, Treaty or NRE Account
articles.excerpt: A Mint explainer walks through why Article 6 leaves India's right to tax Mumbai rent intact, why Article 25 relief comes as a US foreign tax credit, and why the account the rent lands in changes nothing.
articles.nri_angle: US-based NRIs renting out property in India get the treaty's actual mechanism — Indian tax first, US credit second — instead of the two most common misconceptions about it.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Seeks Quick Fix as UK Flags 162.5% Bulk Scotch Duty
articles.excerpt: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal says officials are taking legal opinion to resolve, within days, a customs classification dispute that has pushed bulk Scotch duties above their pre-deal level.
articles.nri_angle: The dispute tests the India-UK pact diaspora businesses celebrated, and decides whether the Scotch price cuts Indian consumers saw in July survive.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Falls More Than 1,100 Points as Profit Booking Ends Rally's Winning Streak
articles.excerpt: Investors lost over Rs 5.33 lakh crore in Monday's intraday sell-off, as a weaker rupee, US rate-hike expectations and heavyweight selling compounded profit booking after a record run.
articles.nri_angle: NRI portfolios holding Indian equities took a Rs 5.33 lakh crore intraday mark-down, though both benchmarks remain within about 3% of record highs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adani Energy Wins 25-Year Bengal Deal for 1,750 MW of Round-the-Clock Renewable Power
articles.excerpt: The Letter of Award from WBSEDCL covers 1,750 MW from July 2028, with a 750 MW option that would take the total to 2,500 MW if exercised. No tariff or contract value was disclosed.
articles.image_caption: Archival photograph: Gautam Adani (right) at an event in West Bengal in September 2026. Adani Energy Solutions said its subsidiary has won a 25-year award to supply 1,750 MW of round-the-clock renewable power to the state discom.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors tracking Adani group stocks, the investable facts are the awarded 1,750 MW and 2028 start — the 2,500 MW headline includes an unexercised option, and no tariff was disclosed.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street's AI Selloff Deepens as S&P 500 and Dow Confirm Correction
articles.excerpt: The Nasdaq fell 5.28% on Friday and erased its 2026 gains as Anthropic's debut fizzled and Nvidia slid 13.8%, pushing the S&P 500 and the Dow more than 10% below their record closes.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rupee Closes Above 93 for First Time in Seven Months, at 92.67 to the Dollar
articles.excerpt: A fifth straight session of gains, powered by ₹84,290 crore of foreign equity inflows in nine November sessions and weaker crude, took the rupee past a level it last closed above on April 10.
articles.image_caption: A graphic shows the US dollar and Indian rupee symbols side by side.
articles.nri_angle: A rupee at 92.67 means each dollar remitted to India converts to fewer rupees than a week ago, while a sustained rally would ease India's import bill.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Walmart Earnings Beat Estimates as Revenue Rises 5.2% to $188.8 Billion, Guidance Raised
articles.excerpt: Adjusted earnings of $0.65 a share topped expectations as U.S. online sales grew 23%, even as an investment swing cut reported profit and Flipkart's sale timing weighed on international results.
articles.image_caption: A Walmart store exterior. Walmart reported fiscal third-quarter revenue of $188.8 billion, up 5.2%, and raised its guidance.

sources.label: Zacks — WMT Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Strong Digital Sales Lift Outlook
Morningstar / Dow Jones — Walmart Raises Fiscal Year Guidance Amid 3Q Earnings Beat

articles.nri_angle: Walmart's India business through Flipkart is central to its international results; the Big Billion Days timing shift weighed on Q3 international eCommerce and advertising and is expected to benefit Q4.

articles.title: South Korea Passes $1 Trillion in Exports, Fourth Country Ever, on AI Chip Boom
articles.excerpt: A one-year leap from last year's $709 billion record, powered by Samsung and SK hynix memory sales into the AI data-centre build-out.
articles.nri_angle: Korea's chip-led surge is the supply side of the AI boom that diaspora tech workers and investors are riding from the demand side in the US.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 24 VC Firms Commit ₹1,050 Crore to Deeptech Startups at Bengaluru Tech Summit
articles.excerpt: Commitments announced at the Future Makers Conclave are 2.6 times last year's ₹400 crore, aimed at aerospace, defence, AI, robotics and semiconductor startups — with no disbursement schedule yet shared.
articles.image_caption: Exhibition stalls and visitors at the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026, held at the Bengaluru International Exhibition Centre. Twenty-four venture capital firms announced ₹1,050.42 crore in deeptech investment commitments at the summit's Future Makers Conclave.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors and founders track India's deeptech funding rounds closely; the test of this announcement is how much of the ₹1,050 crore is actually disbursed, and to whom.

articles.title: Fed Minutes Show Officials Flagging AI Boom and High Valuations as Stability Risks
articles.excerpt: Policymakers at the October 27-28 meeting named elevated valuations, hedge fund leverage and opaque AI financing among the system's biggest vulnerabilities, even as staff called the system resilient.
articles.nri_angle: US rate and stability signals drive the portfolios, mortgages and remittance timing of Indian households in the US; the December 8-9 meeting is the next marker.

articles.image_caption: A graphic balances the US dollar against the Indian rupee. The rupee rose to a seven-month high of about ₹93.40 per dollar on November 18, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: A stronger rupee trims what dollar remittances buy in India and reshapes the reported earnings of the IT firms many diaspora investors and employees are tied to.

articles.image_caption: Nvidia headquarters in Santa Clara, California (file photo)
articles.nri_angle: AI and chip stocks are core holdings in many Indian-American retirement and brokerage portfolios, and Nvidia's earnings on Tuesday will set the tone for the sector those portfolios track.

articles.image_caption: The Adani logo on a group office building.

articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai. Foreign portfolio investors bought Indian equities at a five-year-high pace in early November.
articles.nri_angle: Foreign flows into Indian equities move the Sensex, the Nifty and the rupee — the benchmarks diaspora investors track for their India portfolios and remittance timing.

articles.title: Chris Wood: India Wins the 'Reverse AI Trade', Energy Hedges the Iran Risk
articles.excerpt: In his latest GREED & fear note, Jefferies' Chris Wood argues the AI spending cycle has peaked and foreign money is rotating into India - while fresh US-Iran tensions are the biggest risk to the trade.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors, Wood's rotation call puts India - out of favour for two years - back at the centre of emerging-market portfolios, with oil-driven geopolitics as the named risk.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs Sees India Growing 7.2% in 2027, Well Ahead of China's 4.5%
articles.excerpt: Goldman Sachs Research forecasts global growth of 2.8% in 2027 on rising AI investment and easing oil prices, with India's 7.2% forecast above the 6.8% consensus — and risks tilted to the downside.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors weighing India exposure, Goldman's 7.2% India forecast for 2027 sits above consensus, but the bank flags the same AI and energy drivers as its main downside risks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Foreign Investors Pump ₹84,290 Crore Into Indian Stocks in November's First Fortnight
articles.excerpt: After pulling ₹70,704 crore out in September and October, FPIs returned in nine straight sessions as AI stocks sold off globally, crude fell 13% and large-caps looked cheap — but strategists call the turn tactical, not structural.
articles.image_caption: A pedestrian walks past a large rupee symbol installation. Foreign portfolio investors put a net Rs 84,290 crore into Indian equities in the first fortnight of November, reversing two months of outflows.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors, the ₹84,290 crore fortnight is a sentiment turn worth noting but not chasing: strategists describe tactical, index-heavy buying that has recovered only a fraction of 2026's ₹2.1 lakh crore net outflow.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India-Egypt Trade at $6.5 Billion Is 'Just a Beginning,' Goyal Says in Cairo
articles.excerpt: On a visit with a 132-member business delegation, the commerce minister pitched two-way trade and investment — and asked the Indian community in Egypt to write a modern 'Periplus' business guide for the route.
articles.image_caption: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal speaks at an event. Goyal is visiting Egypt with a 132-member business delegation, pitching a much larger two-way trade and investment partnership.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian exporters and the Indian business community in Egypt, Goyal's Cairo pitch names the sectors to watch — textiles, autos, pharma, ports and logistics — and a rupee settlement channel already live via SBI and Banque Misr.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tamil Nadu Investment Panel Sets $72 Billion Export Target at First Meeting
articles.excerpt: The Tamil Nadu Investment Promotion Commission, chaired by Chief Secretary Sai Kumar, reviewed 112 MoUs worth ₹1.14 lakh crore and fast-tracked work on a New Industrial Policy for 2027.
articles.image_caption: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, hands folded in greeting beside his official vehicle. The Investment Promotion Commission formed by his government held its first meeting on Friday and set a target of raising state exports to $72 billion.
articles.nri_angle: Tamil Nadu is one of India's largest exporter states and a major source of the global Tamil diaspora; its investment and jobs push shapes opportunities for families and businesses with roots in the state.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
